text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: This year's spring Tenno Sho is about to begin! Who will seize glory today? Hang in there, folks, because we're about to find out!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I wish Oguri Cap and Super Creek were running today.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: No point getting upset about that now! Those two announced forever ago that they'd be skipping the spring season.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: Inari One's popularity may not hold a candle to Oguri Cap and Super Creek…

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: But I'm sure she'll prove here at the Tenno Sho that she's got what it takes to be Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Who will seize glory today? Hang in there, folks, because we're about to find out!

text_block_list.name: Townsman
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's almost time! The spring Tenno Sho's 'bout to start. C'mon, Inari! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Townswoman
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, I've got butterflies! I hope Inari's takin' good care of herself. Do ya think she's eatin' enough?

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! I can't believe she's really runnin' today!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So this is the spring Tenno Sho… Gotta say, I never felt so much pressure at a racecourse before.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sucks that Oguri and Creek aren't here, but the other racers are the real deal. I gotta get creative if I wanna win.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Time to dig my heels in 'n' brace myself! If I don't give it my all here, my goal of becomin' Umamusume of the Year's gonna stay a pipe dream forever!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I've gotta do this for everyone else too…
choice_data_list: You're gonna psych yourself out at this rate.
You're gonna psych yourself out at this rate.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I know… But I'm gonna win! No matter what!
